from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
H,W,_ = im.shape
r,g,b = im[...,0].astype(int),im[...,1].astype(int),im[...,2].astype(int)
mx = np.maximum(np.maximum(r,g),b); mn=np.minimum(np.minimum(r,g),b)
sat = mx-mn
# categories
def ch(r,g,b):
    out=np.full(r.shape,'.',dtype='<U1')
    out[(mx>200)&(sat<40)]='W'   # white
    out[(mx>120)&(mx<=200)&(sat<30)]='g'  # light gray
    out[(mx>60)&(mx<=120)&(sat<35)]='G'   # mid gray
    out[(mx<=60)]='#'                    # dark
    brown=(r>g+8)&(g>=b)&(sat>25)&(r>70)
    out[brown]='B'
    out[(r>100)&(g>70)&(b<90)&(sat>30)]='b'
    return out
lab=ch(r,g,b)
# downsample 4x4 majority
for y in range(0,H,4):
    row=''
    for x in range(0,W,4):
        block=lab[y:y+4,x:x+4]
        vals,counts=np.unique(block,return_counts=True)
        row+=vals[counts.argmax()]
    print(row)
\""
